paraphrase: Proposes asymmetric verification with three tiers proportional to blast radius: (1) cheap inline checks for low-risk, (2) structured checks with provenance for medium-risk, (3) full independent re-execution for high-risk. The question is not 'verify or skip?' but 'what is the cheapest check proportional to blast radius?'

claims.text: Verification should be asymmetric: cheapest check proportional to blast radius, not one-size-fits-all
claims.notes: Three-tier model with concrete escalation criteria

evaluation.notes: Practical tiering similar to reaworks. Both suggest receipt field sets should vary by risk tier.
